ingredients.name: Abyssfin Fillet
ingredients.description: A rare night-catch cut prized for premium restaurant dishes and raw-bar specials.
ingredients.description_zh: 稀有的夜间渔获切片，适合高价招牌菜和生食特供。

ingredients.name: Glow Kelp
ingredients.description: A bright trench frond that turns into premium noodle specials and unlocks riskier kitchen experiments.
ingredients.description_zh: 明亮的海沟藻叶，可做成高价面食特餐，也能解锁更冒险的厨房尝试。

ingredients.name: Reef Salt
ingredients.description: Crystalline salt scraped from night reefs, best saved for the restaurant's highest-ticket seafood plate.
ingredients.description_zh: 从夜间礁区刮取的晶盐，最适合留给最贵的海鲜招牌菜。

ingredients.name: Moon Spore
ingredients.description: Bioluminescent spores that stabilize into Mooncap Mycelium for a premium farm crop.
ingredients.description_zh: 带生物荧光的孢子，可稳定成月菇菌丝，培育高价农作物。

ingredients.name: Lumen Resin
ingredients.description: A convoy-grade resin pull used to annotate support routes and steady escort planning.
ingredients.description_zh: 一种护航级树脂样本，常被用来标记支援路线并稳定护送规划。

ingredients.name: Coil Fragment
ingredients.description: Recovered relay hardware that points toward better market stock and cleaner loadout tuning.
ingredients.description_zh: 从中继设备上拆下的线圈碎片，常用来锁定更好的市场货池和更干净的武装调校。

ingredients.name: Challenge Seal
ingredients.description: A stamped proof that a high-risk room was held, often traded into sharper route leverage.
ingredients.description_zh: 高风险房间被稳住后留下的印记，常被兑换成更强的路线筹码。

ingredients.name: Blueprint Fragment
ingredients.description: A rougher route-found fragment that still folds into kitchen and market unlock work.
ingredients.description_zh: 从路线深处捞出的粗糙蓝图片段，依然能并入厨房和市场相关的解锁研究。

ingredients.name: Kitchen Blueprint Fragment
ingredients.description: Recovered night notes that piece together high-value recipe unlocks and chef progression.
ingredients.description_zh: 从夜里带回的厨房笔记残片，可拼出高价值食谱与主厨成长路线。
